Many in organization studies and business ethics will be familiar with the rise and fall of Theranos:a biotech company started by Elizabeth Holmes that hit a 9-billion-dollar valuation just before leadership was indicted on charges of fraud.

It is easy look at this case study and draw the conclusion that such circumstances are rare:to hold up the example of Elizabeth Holmes as a fanatical egomaniac.
